LanguageData.VoidAwake_Ghost.label: ghost
LanguageData.VoidAwake_Ghost.description: A skeletal ghost that fights with a longsword, feels no pain, and charges the living. It is vulnerable to explosives.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_GhostMusket.label: musket ghost
LanguageData.VoidAwake_GhostMusket.description: A skeletal ghost armed with a musket. Long range, slow to fire. It is vulnerable to explosives.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_GhostAcid.label: acid-flask ghost
LanguageData.VoidAwake_GhostAcid.description: A skeletal ghost that throws acid flasks, scorching the ground around the impact. It is vulnerable to explosives.
